official_statement_rationale: I vote to maintain the repo rate at 6.50%, but I dissent on the stance. The persistence of the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is no longer supported by the macroeconomic data. With core inflation at 3.25%, significantly below the 4.00% target, the real policy rate is already sufficiently restrictive to anchor inflation expectations. The headline CPI of 4.85% is driven by food inflation of 8.52%, a supply-side phenomenon that is largely unresponsive to interest rate adjustments. Given the modest positive output gap of 0.40% and the ongoing growth momentum of 6.30%, continuing to signal a withdrawal of accommodation risks an unnecessary sacrifice of growth. A neutral stance is the appropriate reflection of a policy rate that has already reached a level consistent with the objective of durably aligning inflation with the target while supporting economic activity.
